summary: Implemented the round-3 frontend refactor: compact 6-candidate preview cards, score-hidden main UI, and a slot-based final swap editor with immediate cross-role/cross-team updates. Added pure editor helpers, preserved optimizer ranking rules, updated docs, and extended automated coverage.
completed_work: Refactored result rendering in `src/lib/render.js` and `src/styles.css` to show compact `팀 A / 팀 B` candidate previews, tier-color chips/cards, and a single editable final board without visible numeric score UI.

Added editable slot state with `src/lib/editor.js`, wired candidate reload and two-click swapping through `src/lib/appFlow.js` and `src/main.js`, and ensured cross-role swaps recompute displayed tier data from the destination slot role.
Extended candidate data in `src/lib/optimizer.js` with stable slot metadata while preserving ranking priority and existing optimization behavior.
Kept parser behavior intact in `src/lib/parseClipboard.js`, adding stable player ids for editor mapping while preserving optional-header support and Korean validation.

Updated browser smoke logic in `scripts/browserSmoke.mjs` for the new UI contract and added/updated tests in `test/editor.test.js`, `test/appFlow.test.js`, `test/optimizer.test.js`, `test/responsiveLayout.test.js`, and `test/browserSmoke.test.js`.
Rewrote `README.md` and `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` to document the compact preview workflow, score-hidden UI rule, swap editing behavior, and the non-blocking browser verification gap.

verification.result: Passed. 6 test files succeeded, covering parsing, optimizer ranking/uniqueness, editor swap logic, main fake-DOM flow, responsive CSS contract, and browser smoke assertions.

known_gaps: Real browser-engine smoke coverage remains unverified in this sandbox because no Chromium-family browser was installed. This is documented and treated as non-blocking for this round per spec.
Mobile/real-device validation is still not evidenced beyond automated layout and DOM-contract tests.
handoff_notes: Candidate card clicks now always load a fresh editable copy of that candidate and clear prior swap state; QA should verify that this reset behavior is the intended UX.
The main UI intentionally hides personal scores, team totals, and numeric score-difference labels; ranking metrics still exist internally for tests and ordering.
`dist/` was rebuilt after the source changes.
`.harness/spec.md` and `.harness/plan.json` showed pre-existing worktree modifications and were left untouched.
